summary: Iteration 151 - Multi-Currency GL Consolidation (P1) Testing Complete. Backend: 15/15 tests passed. Frontend: All UI elements verified, all 5 tabs working, modal forms functional, converter shows correct results.

tests: GET /api/currency-fx/settings returns base_currency (GBP), available_codes (10+), symbols, rounding_mode
PUT /api/currency-fx/settings updates base_currency and rounding_mode correctly
GET /api/currency-fx/rates returns list with 10 seeded currencies (GBP/USD/EUR/TRY/AED/JPY/CAD/AUD/CHF/INR)
POST /api/currency-fx/rates upserts by (code, as_of) - no duplicates on same-day updates
DELETE /api/currency-fx/rates/{code} works for non-base currencies
DELETE /api/currency-fx/rates/GBP returns 400 - cannot delete base currency
POST /api/currency-fx/convert: 100 EUR @ 0.86 = 86 GBP (correct)
POST /api/currency-fx/convert: same-currency returns amount unchanged
POST /api/currency-fx/convert: USD to EUR via base currency works correctly
GET /api/currency-fx/ar-aging returns buckets (current/d30/d60/d90/over90), total, by_currency[], invoice_count
AR aging converts city-ledger invoice balances from native → base using latest rates
GET /api/currency-fx/portfolio-summary returns per-property revenue/AR in native + base, and totals object
data-testid='currency-fx-btn' in sidebar opens CurrencyFxPanel (data-testid='currency-fx-panel')
All 5 tabs switch correctly: fx-tab-overview, fx-tab-ar, fx-tab-rates, fx-tab-convert, fx-tab-settings
fx-new-rate button opens Add FX Rate modal
Modal contains fx-form-code, fx-form-rate, fx-form-save elements
Saving rate adds it to the rate table
Converter tab has fx-convert-amount, fx-convert-from, fx-convert-to, fx-convert-btn
Converting 100 EUR → GBP shows £86.00 result card
Settings tab has fx-base-currency selector
Changing base currency triggers save (toast + reload)
GET /settings requires authentication (401)
GET /rates requires authentication (401)
POST /convert requires authentication (401)

critical_code_review_comments: All Currency FX endpoints are fully functional end-to-end
FX rate auto-seeding works correctly on first call (10 currencies with realistic rates)
Upsert logic by (code, as_of) prevents duplicate rates for same day
Base currency protection (GBP) correctly returns 400 on delete attempt
Conversion math is correct: normalizes via base currency for cross-currency conversions
AR aging correctly buckets invoices by days overdue and converts to base currency
Portfolio summary aggregates revenue and AR per property with proper currency conversion
Frontend panel has all required data-testid attributes for testing
UI design is clean with good color contrast and proper spacing
seed_data_creation: FX rates auto-seeded on first API call. Test rate TST created and deleted during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 151 tested the Multi-Currency GL Consolidation (P1) feature. All 8 backend endpoints work correctly: settings (GET/PUT), rates (GET/POST/DELETE), convert (POST), ar-aging (GET), portfolio-summary (GET). Frontend panel loads correctly with all 5 tabs (overview, ar, rates, convert, settings). The converter correctly shows 100 EUR = £86.00 GBP. AR aging shows £1,500.00 total open AR in GBP. Portfolio shows £365,928.12 total revenue across 9 properties.
